content: {"episode_id":"ep-05026","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, for episode ep-05026. The clinical indication note states the patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of atrial fibrillation, raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia recurrence. The note further states that given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, continuous monitoring is indicated to detect potential embolic sources or rhythm disturbances that may have been missed on standard ECG. The claim was submitted with diagnosis codes Z86.73, I48.91, and R00.2, and an outstanding balance of 549.76 remains."}
